source_text: Non erunt tibi dii alii praeter me. Multi dii et domini in mundo; nobis unus Deus Pater et unus Dominus Iesus. Idolum — quidquid amas supra Deum.
pass_a_gloss: Not will-be to-you gods other besides me. Many gods and lords in world; to-us one God Father and one Lord Jesus. Idol — whatever you-love above God.
pass_b_english: [[You shall have no other gods besides me >> Bible:Exodus 20:3]]. There are [[many gods and many lords >> Bible:1 Corinthians 8:5]]; for us one God the Father and one Lord Jesus. An idol is whatever you love above God.
